name: kickoff depth
description: #397 stage 2 (balance/plans/kickoff-depth.md): does the deeper default kick-off (the receivers' 15–8 m line by the kicker's Skill, 35–42 m from halfway, instead of their 24 m line, about 26 m) keep points, tries, completion and possession inside the §7 bands, for even sides, a rating gap and the attacking and defence styles? Baseline is today's kick-off (kickoff.deepDefault 0); the variant turns the deeper default on. No coach calls.
